title: The minimum setup you need for AI
description:
The computer you need to actually build with AI.

He breaks down why a Mac with at least 16 gigs of RAM is the real minimum if you want to build automation or implement AI for a business. Browsing AI in a browser works on any device, but building it for clients is different. Windows, Chromebooks, tablets, and Linux machines will not cut it for this kind of work.

#AI #Automation #SmallBusiness #Tech
